run_multi_hop_fever_evaluation: run the multi-hop dense retrieval evaluation script on FEVER claims using a trained RobertaRetriever model
run_faiss_index_search: run a FAISS inner product index search over 768-dimensional embeddings to retrieve top-k candidate documents
run_two_hop_beam_search: run a two-hop beam search that encodes claim-document pairs and retrieves second-hop evidence passages
run_dense_retrieval_with_gpu: run the dense retrieval evaluation with GPU acceleration using FAISS GPU resources and Apex AMP
run_fever_retrieval_with_save: run the FEVER multi-hop retrieval pipeline and save candidate evidence chains to a JSON output file
